latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "Engineering as Marketing" skill for customer acquisition via free tools.

- Enables founders and marketers to design lead-generating tools, calculators, widgets, graders, or micro-sites.
- Guides users through identifying core customer questions, scoping the smallest useful tool, and planning lead capture post-value delivery.
- Emphasizes the single-input-field pattern for maximum conversion and minimal friction.
- Offers clear process steps, input requirements, and best practices for tool-based growth campaigns.
- Targets startups with available engineering capacity and a need for scalable, product-led growth channels.
